title: Burg Kropfsberg St. Gertraudi
highlights: Imposante Festungsruine der Salzburger Erzbischöfe an der Zillertalmündung
Markanter romanischer Bergfried und erhaltene Ringmauern aus dem 13. Jahrhundert
Strategischer Wachposten über das Inntal und den Eingang ins Zillertal
Idyllischer Wanderweg von St. Gertraudi hinauf zu den Burgmauern
kurzbeschreibung: The castle ruin Burg Kropfsberg near St. Gertraudi was once a mighty fortress of the Salzburg archbishops overlooking the Inntal.
beschreibung:
Fortified Stronghold at the Confluence of Two Valleys

The Burg Kropfsberg sits majestically on a rocky ridge near St. Gertraudi in the municipality of Reith im Alpbachtal. Founded in the 13th century by Erzbischof Konrad IV. von Salzburg, the stronghold secured the archiepiscopal possessions in the Zillertal against the Counts of Tirol for centuries.

Medieval Monument in Lush Greenery

With its two formidable towers and extensive curtain walls, Burg Kropfsberg was once one of the largest castles in Tirol. Today, the historic grounds welcome visitors for idyllic walks accompanied by panoramic vistas across the lower Inntal.
